equity_bridge.item: Sinopharm Industrial Investment (49% associate) at market look-through
equity_bridge.note: Book RMB21,857m (H1 2026 segment note, 2196.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:4111). Fosun's 49% share of Sinopharm Industrial attributable profit was RMB1,763m in FY2025 (AR note: 3,597.9 x 49%). Its value is a stake in Sinopharm Group (1099.HK, HKD15.72 on 2026-10-16, ~6x P/E, ~0.55x book). 6.2x the look-through earnings = ~RMB11.0bn, about 0.5x book. Its income is outside the flows.

equity_bridge.note: Associates 27,951.9 less Sinopharm Industrial 21,856.9 = 6,095.0, plus JVs 531.2 (30 Jun 2026 balance sheet). Carried at book: a mix of listed and unlisted healthcare holdings, no market marks taken.

equity_bridge.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
equity_bridge.note: 828.3 non-current + 2,430.7 current, 30 Jun 2026 (fair value already). Dividend and FV income is outside the flows.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 5.7% vs EPS 5yr CAGR -2.3%: equity has grown through retained gains, disposals and NCI injections while per-share earnings fell (FY2021 peak RMB1.85 -> FY2025 RMB1.27). Revenue 3yr CAGR is negative (-1.8%) on the post-COVID product roll-off and VBP. The projection does not use 5.7%; base growth is 3.5-5.5%.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC; interest income not deducted because the group is net-debt) was negative every year FY2018-FY2023 and turned positive only in FY2024-25 as capex fell from 5.9bn to 4.4bn. FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative start). SBC is small but rose ~10x in FY2025 and again in H1 2026.

scenario_narratives.base: Innovative drugs keep compounding at low-to-mid teens and overseas revenue at mid-teens, but VBP renewals keep shrinking the generics base and healthcare services keep contracting, so group revenue grows 3.5-5.5% before fading to 3%. Mix shift and steady out-licensing income lift adj. EBITDA margin from 17.3% to 19.5%. Capitalised development and capex ease from 11.5% to 9% of revenue as the Henlius and Gland capacity build-out completes. Cash tax normalises from 33% to 28%. Associates (Sinopharm) and NCI are valued at today's marks.
scenario_narratives.bull: The innovation-and-internationalisation pivot works: serplulimab's EU indications, US/EU biosimilar launches (denosumab, pertuzumab), CAR-T label expansion and a recurring stream of out-licensing upfronts and milestones (Pfizer YP05002 up to US$2.1bn, Sitala, Expedition, Sandoz) push growth to 8-9% in FY2027-29. Innovative drugs become the majority of pharma revenue, EBITDA margin reaches 22.5%, capex falls to 8.5% and the tax rate drops to 26% as profits concentrate in high-tech-rate entities.
scenario_narratives.bear: VBP and NRDL renegotiation cut generics and older biosimilars faster than innovation grows, PD-1 and biosimilar competition from Hengrui, Innovent, Junshi and multinationals caps pricing, and US-China tension slows licensing and FDA access. Revenue grows 1-2.5% a year, margin slips to 16.5%, capex stays at 10% to defend the pipeline, cash tax stays at 32% because the loss-making R&D entities never reach taxable profit, and the terminal multiple is 12x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: This is a strict owner-FCF valuation of the consolidated operating business. It charges all expensed R&D, capitalised development, SBC and lease cash, and gives no credit for other gains, which have been recurring (FY2025 RMB1.99bn, FY2024 RMB1.01bn). The parent's holdings enter the bridge at value: Sinopharm at market look-through, other associates at book, financial assets at fair value. Net debt and NCI at book are deducted. On this basis the group is worth well below the H-share price. FY2025 consolidated owner FCF was ~RMB0.56bn before leases and about zero after them, against a market cap of roughly RMB38bn at the H-share quote. The market is paying for things this model does not count: pipeline optionality and the listed subsidiaries' market values. SOTP cross-check: Fosun's 51.83% of Gland Pharma is ~RMB17bn at GLAND.NS (INR3,043, 2026-10-16), and its majority stake in Henlius (2696.HK, HKD51.35) is worth a further high-teens RMB bn at market. Together with the Sinopharm look-through (~RMB11bn) and other holdings, that covers most of the market cap before net debt and before the wholly-owned generics, devices and hospitals businesses. The gap between this model and that SOTP is the price of believing those subsidiaries' market multiples.
key_risks_to_valuation: Pipeline optionality and licensing milestones are only in the bull flows; a run of large out-licensing deals would make the base case too low
Listed-subsidiary market values (Henlius, Gland) far exceed their DCF-implied share of value; the SOTP and owner-FCF answers diverge sharply
Disposal gains are excluded as non-recurring but have recurred every year; ~RMB1bn/yr of realised gains capitalised would add materially
Sinopharm look-through at ~0.5x book: a re-rating of Sinopharm Group moves the bridge by RMB1bn per 0.05x of book
NCI at book understates the minorities' claim on market value (Gland's NCI alone is ~RMB16bn at market)
RMB/HKD rate is static at 1.1724; refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (2196.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 14.90-24.72. FX from CNYHKD=X; parity against 600196.SS. Cross-check marks: 1099.HK, 2696.HK, GLAND.NS, INRCNY=X, all 2026-10-16.
data_sources.financials: 2196.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (RMB millions); FY2025 annual report statements (2196.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt lines 7380-7840, note 42 NCI, Sinopharm Industrial associate note ~11680-11710); H1 2026 interim balance sheet, income statement and segment note (2196.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt 3478-3682, 4089-4111, 4443-4445).

inputs.share_count_basis: Total A+H shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 (H1 2026 interim), 2,639.554m, after the FY2025 repurchase-and-cancel programme. Diluted EPS equals basic (RMB1.27 FY2025), so no material dilutive securities. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows. A and H shares carry identical economic rights, so the per-share value applies to both; it is compared with the H-share quote.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity settled share-based payment' RMB207,245k (2196.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:7770). No net-share-settlement tax line exists (A/H restricted-share schemes), so the add-back is the full charge. H1 2026 SBC was RMB295m (1.45% of half-year revenue) as new A-share and Henlius incentive schemes vest, which is why the forward path starts at 1.4%, not the FY2025 0.5%.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-16T22:01Z). Every flow and bridge item is in RMB millions; per-share values are converted to HKD at this rate so the unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv compare with the H-share quote. Parity check against the A-share (600196.SS, regular close 2026-10-16): the A-share price in CNY times 1.1724 is ~57% above the H-share quote. That is the structural A/H premium for this name, not an FX error; the direction (A converts to a higher HKD figure than H) confirms the rate is CNY->HKD and not inverted.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z HKEX regular close (Friday); Yahoo Finance chart API; 52-week range 14.90-24.72
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency. Risk-free ~1.8% (10y China government bond), ERP ~6.5%, beta ~1.1 -> cost of equity ~9.0%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~3.3% (bank loans 0.30-5.25%, H1 2026 interest ~RMB607m on ~RMB35bn), ~2.5% after 25% tax. Target D/V ~25% -> ~7.4%, rounded to 7.5%. Same rate in every scenario: VBP, NCI and Fosun-group governance risk are carried in the bear flows and the 25% bear weight, not a WACC premium (adaptations f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. lease_cost_pct_path 1.4% of revenue = principal + lease interest (FY2025: 488.3 principal + 134.1 interest = 622.4 = 1.50%; H1 2026: 211.2 principal + ~70 interest = ~1.38%). Lease liabilities (RMB3,238.6m at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PPE 1,994.0 + intangibles 1,306.2 = 3,300.2 = 7.95%; H1 2026: 954.2 + 649.8 = 7.87%), so cash-tax EBIT does not charge the lease twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows (100% of Gland Pharma, Henlius, etc.); NCI deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at book, RMB14,670.7m (30 Jun 2026). Cross-check: NCI took RMB877m of FY2025 profit, ~15x that is ~RMB13.2bn, close to book. Market value of the listed minorities is far higher (Gland Pharma's 48.17% NCI alone is ~RMB16bn at GLAND.NS on 2026-10-16) but deducting market-valued NCI against a DCF-valued operating business would be inconsistent; the gap is the market paying for pipeline value this owner-FCF model does not credit (see valuation_philosophy).
inputs.associates_treatment: Share of associates' profit (RMB1,932m FY2025, ~38% of pre-tax profit) and associate dividends (RMB601m, in investing cash flow) are NOT in the operating flows; the associates enter the bridge at value (matching-asset rule, adaptations d). Interest income is likewise outside the flows (net-debt company; cash is netted in net_debt).
inputs.ebitda_definition: Adj. EBITDA = gross profit + other income - selling - admin - impairment of financial assets - R&D (all expensed R&D charged) + D&A + SBC; EXCLUDES other gains (FY2025 RMB1,993m, mostly disposal and fair-value gains), other expenses (RMB919m), interest, and associates/JVs. FY2024 15.5%, FY2025 16.9%, H1 2026 17.5% (H1 2025 16.1%). Licensing revenue (FY2025 RMB621m) is inside revenue and margin.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF component route with the non-US adaptations (CNY flows / HKD quote, IFRS-16 leases treatment B, material NCI, large associate portfolio). Routed as an operating pharmaceutical manufacturer per dcf-methods SKILL.md; no prior DCF and no MEMORY.md entry, so this is a fresh build. Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 764.8 (OCF 5,213.2 - capex 4,448.5) - SBC 207.2 = 557.5; after lease cash of 622.4 it is about -65, i.e. the consolidated operating business currently converts almost nothing to free cash after capitalised development and leases, and FY2025 OCF was flattered by a RMB1,236m inventory release. Capex includes capitalised development and licensed-in intangibles (intangible amortisation rose from 984 to 1,306). BUYBACKS: FY2024 RMB238m and FY2025 RMB412m actually spent, H1 2026 nil -- the flat count was partly funded, but the FY2025 programme was the main one and is not assumed to recur. GUIDANCE: no numeric FY2026 guidance; H1 2026 revenue +4.9% reported / +7.3% constant currency, innovative drugs +13.8%, overseas +16.5%. FY2026 growth 3.5% sits between the reported H1 rate and the FY2025 +1.4%, allowing for RMB strength and continuing generics VBP cuts in H2.

bear.capex_rationale: Capex eases only to 9.5% (vs 9.0% base): the pipeline still needs funding, but management cuts discretionary capacity build when growth stalls. Still above 8.2% D&A.

base.cash_tax_rationale: FY2025 cash tax 1,073.8 on component EBIT of ~2,880 = 37%: tax is paid on disposal gains and by profitable subsidiaries while loss-making R&D entities cannot group-relieve. Ramped to 28% (25% statutory, 15% high-tech rate at some subsidiaries, offset by non-deductible R&D losses and Indian tax at Gland).
base.wc_rationale: Manufacturer/distributor with receivables + inventory well above payables (FY2025 receivables +1,387); growth consumes ~20% of incremental revenue.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: price-setting risk sits with a single buyer (China's NHSA through VBP/NRDL), there is about RMB22bn of net debt (~64% short-term) and ~37% of consolidated operating profit goes to minorities, and the Fosun International parent is still de-levering. Bull lowered from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right together (EU/US biosimilar uptake, licensing milestones paying out, margin expansion despite rising R&D). Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
